auth.not_configured: auth.tretu.de is not set up here (TRETU_AUTH_ISSUER and TRETU_APP_SECRET are missing).
auth.unavailable: auth.tretu.de cannot be reached right now. Please try again in a moment.
auth.unauthorized: auth.tretu.de did not accept the request (signature). Check TRETU_APP_SECRET and TRETU_APPS_JSON on both sides.
auth.not_found: auth.tretu.de does not know this account.
auth.rate_limited: auth.tretu.de is throttling requests. Please wait a moment.
auth.forbidden_app: auth.tretu.de accepts admin requests from tretu.de only (TRETU_APP_ID must be “tretu-web”).
auth.actor_not_admin: Your Tretu account no longer holds the admin role on auth.tretu.de, or it is locked.
auth.actor_two_factor_required: Turn on 2FA in My account to use the admin.
auth.self_action: You cannot do that to your own account.
auth.last_admin: This is the last active admin. Without it Tretu would have no admin left: give the role to someone else first.
auth.last_sign_in_method: This is the account's only way to sign in and cannot be removed.
auth.no_email: This account has no email address.
auth.merge_refused: auth.tretu.de refuses this merge: same account, or the old account holds the admin role (remove it first).
auth.payload_too_large: The request is too large for auth.tretu.de.

actorBlocked.actor_not_admin: The account admin stays closed until your Tretu account holds the admin role again. Sign in again afterwards.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Search Tretu accounts: username, name, email, Tretu ID, Discord ID, Minecraft name or UUID, Steam ID or TeamSpeak UID.

account.notFound: This Tretu account does not exist (any more).
account.authError: The account data from auth.tretu.de is missing right now.
account.name: Name

actions.title: Actions
actions.addRoleDescription: Global role of the Tretu account. “admin” applies in every app; auth.tretu.de requires 2FA for it.
actions.removeRoleDescription: The role is removed from the Tretu account. Apps apply this on the next sign-in or right away via the event.
actions.revokeSessionsDescription: Signs the account out everywhere: auth.tretu.de (sessions and refresh tokens) and tretu.de.
actions.lockDescription: Sign-in is refused, all sessions end, apps sign the account out. Without an end date the lock lasts until unlocked.
actions.unlockDescription: The account can sign in again.
actions.resetTwoFactorDescription: Removes 2FA and backup codes and ends all sessions. Admins have to set up 2FA again.
actions.removeLinkDescription: The sign-in method or game link is removed from the Tretu account. The last sign-in method cannot be removed.
actions.verifyEmailDescription: Only for support cases in which the address was proven otherwise.
actions.unchanged: Nothing to change: the account was already in that state.

merge.title: Merge accounts
merge.description: An old account (“from”) is moved into another Tretu account (“into”): sign-in methods, game links, passkeys, old app accounts, balance and stats move along, the old account is deleted.
merge.deleted: {name} is deleted, {sessions, plural, =0 {with no open sessions} one {# session ends} other {# sessions end}}.
merge.usedByApps: {name} was already used with an app: the apps remove that user after the merge.

legacy.title: Old accounts
legacy.intro: Accounts with old app accounts that no admin has merged yet. Possible matches: same email or same name.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.intro: Tretu Credits across the ecosystem: circulation, flow per day, largest balances, history and corrections.
wallet.adjustDescription: Positive amounts credit, negative amounts debit. Booked as an adjustment; submitting twice books once.
wallet.reverseDescription: Books {amount} TC back (counter-booking). Each transaction can be reversed only once.

badges.title: Badges
badges.intro: All badges with their number of holders and Discord / TeamSpeak mapping. Grant and revoke by hand.
badges.grantDescription: As if earned: XP, one-time credits, notification and Discord / TeamSpeak sync. An earlier revocation is lifted.
badges.revokeDescription: Removes the badge and its XP and takes back the Discord role / TeamSpeak group. Credits already paid stay. The rules will not award it again automatically.
badges.pendingJobs: {count, plural, one {# sync pending} other {# syncs pending}}
badges.resyncDescription: Takes back roles / groups that no longer apply and grants every mapped badge again (also those already granted).
badges.resynced: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to do.} one {# sync queued.} other {# syncs queued.}}

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every admin action on tretu.de, including those forwarded to auth.tretu.de. Failed attempts are marked; actions that changed nothing are marked too.
